title: ProjectEventV1
description: Canonical append-only ledger event schema for POWER Project State Engine (PSE) v1.

event_id.description: Unique deterministic or random identifier for the event

schema_version.description: Canonical schema version identifier for stored ProjectEvent v1

project_id.description: Canonical project identifier independent of filesystem paths

sequence.description: Strictly monotonically increasing positive integer within the project event stream

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event generation

actor.description: Qualified entity originating the mutation (e.g. agent:agy, user:admin)

source.description: Subsystem or transport channel (e.g. cli, mcp, internal_engine, reconciliation)

session_id.description: Optional conversational or operational session identifier

payload.description: Domain-specific structured data associated with the event

payload_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical JSON encoded payload

prev_event_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the immediate predecessor event_hash (empty string for sequence 1)

event_hash.description: SHA-256 digest of POWER Canonical JSON v1 encoding of the complete stored ProjectEvent envelope excluding only the event_hash field itself.

artifact_refs.description: Relative paths or URIs of artifacts bound or mutated by this event

evidence_refs.description: References to verified receipts, test logs, or cryptographic hashes confirming validity

correlation_id.description: Identifier tying multiple events across subsystems into a single user action

causation_id.description: Direct predecessor event_id or command_id that triggered this event

idempotency_key.description: Client-supplied idempotency key preventing duplicate event emission
